reference_sql:
WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per campaign, numbered within its channel from the earliest start
  SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, start_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY start_date, campaign_id) AS rn
  FROM campaigns
)
SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, start_date
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
alternatives:
SELECT r.channel_id, r.campaign_id, r.start_date
FROM (
  -- one row per campaign, numbered within its channel from the earliest start
  SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, start_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY start_date, campaign_id) AS rn
  FROM campaigns
) AS r
WHERE r.rn = 1

SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, start_date
FROM campaigns
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY start_date, campaign_id) = 1
